notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: EO 11957 (January 13, 1977) designated officers of the Department of Agriculture to act as Secretary of Agriculture (Sec. 1) and revoked EO 11793 (Sec. 2). It has no own-terms sunset. Its Sec. 1 designation stayed operative until EO 13241 of December 18, 2001 revoked the whole order in its Sec. 4; Sec. 2 was a self-executing revocation of EO 11793 performed on signing. The status is NO: EO 13241 Sec. 4 ended the order, and the three bounded machine searches (U.S. Code, eCFR, OFR catalog) found no later instrument reviving it.
